correctness.rationale: From D(e_v^2)=2e_vD(e_v), each parent vertex has a diagonal derivation column and diagonal coefficients satisfy d_parent,parent=2d_v,v. Thus one depth-scaled parameter per sink. From D(e_u e_v)=0, off-diagonal coefficients from distinct non-sink vertices vanish unless the vertices are siblings; nonleaf columns are already diagonal, so only leaf siblings contribute X satisfying C_p X+X^T C_p=0. Every leaf may map arbitrarily into every sink: these |S||L| coefficients form an abelian ideal B because S and L are disjoint without isolated roots. Separate sibling blocks commute, as do depth-scalings with each orthogonal block, giving the stated Lie semidirect decomposition. In char 0, so(C_p) is semisimple for lambda_p>=3, one-dimensional abelian for lambda_p=2, zero for lambda_p<=1, proving the exact Levi decomposition and solvability boundary. Independent linear-system rank on 3-leaf star with weights (1,2,3) gave dim 7, and a pair of disjoint 1-leaf components gave dim 6; supplied verify.py independently formulates finite derivation equations for 892 small forests but is not taken as an all-dimension proof.

value.rationale: Gives a full structural, not merely numeric, derivation Lie algebra classification on an unrestricted natural nilpotent graph family; identifies the exact graph-theoretic onset of a non-solvable Levi factor. The dimension and solvability condition serve as reusable invariants distinguishing branching patterns.

final_claim: For every finite characteristic-zero nilpotent evolution algebra whose nonzero basis squares each point to a single basis vector, whose graph is a directed acyclic forest without isolated vertices, the derivation Lie algebra is a semidirect sum of sink scalings, arbitrary maps from leaves into sinks, and orthogonal sibling-leaf factors so(C_p). Its dimension is |S|(1+|L|)+sum_p binom(lambda_p,2); its Levi factor is the sum of so(C_p) for lambda_p>=3 and solvability occurs exactly when every parent has at most two leaf children.
limitations: Does not apply to arbitrary non-functional basis-square support, isolated vertices or positive characteristic.
